before.evidence_summary: ESMO建议在复发时重新评估受体，并在重要差异时据复发组织信息调整管理；差异机制需结合具体标本判断。

before.source_title: Pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy versus placebo plus chemotherapy for previously untreated locally recurrent inoperable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer (KEYNOTE-355)
before.evidence_summary: KEYNOTE-355研究对象为不可手术局部复发或转移性TNBC，CPS≥10亚组获益，不能直接覆盖所有局部复发情境。

before.source_title: Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for metastatic breast cancer
before.evidence_summary: ESMO支持以经确认的复发病灶受体信息指导治疗，并综合既往用药与临床状态。

before.source_title: Pan-Asian adapted ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines for metastatic breast cancer
before.evidence_summary: 复发治疗需可靠的病理和受体依据；本例细胞量不足及PR/HER2缺失是病例中明确的限制。

before.source_title: UK guidelines for the management of soft tissue sarcomas
before.evidence_summary: 乳腺肉瘤应转诊专科团队进行病理复核和多学科讨论。

before.source_title: UK guidelines for the management of soft tissue sarcomas
before.evidence_summary: 乳腺肉瘤不要求常规以前哨活检完成腋窝分期；血管肉瘤仍需关注区域淋巴结。

before.source_title: UK guidelines for the management of soft tissue sarcomas
before.evidence_summary: 乳腺肉瘤标准局部手术为取得阴性切缘的广泛切除，术式根据具体情况选择。

before.source_title: UK guidelines for the management of soft tissue sarcomas
before.evidence_summary: 乳腺肉瘤术后放疗可结合高级别、较大肿瘤和切缘等局部复发风险讨论。

before.source_title: UK guidelines for the management of soft tissue sarcomas
before.evidence_summary: 软组织肉瘤随访关注局部复发、肺部转移和治疗晚期影响，影像检查结合临床怀疑安排。

before.source_title: 2023 GEIS Guidelines for gastrointestinal stromal tumors
before.evidence_summary: GIST诊断可使用KIT、DOG1等免疫表型；分子检测与风险评估服务于后续治疗选择。

before.source_title: 2023 GEIS Guidelines for gastrointestinal stromal tumors
before.evidence_summary: 局限性GIST手术以完整切除和避免破裂为原则，切除范围应兼顾器官功能。

before.source_title: 2023 GEIS Guidelines for gastrointestinal stromal tumors
before.evidence_summary: GIST风险评估考虑肿瘤部位、大小、核分裂活性和破裂，计数需注意面积标准。

before.source_title: 2023 GEIS Guidelines for gastrointestinal stromal tumors
before.evidence_summary: 辅助伊马替尼推荐与高复发风险及敏感基因型相关，不因KIT免疫组化阳性自动适用。

before.source_title: Gastrointestinal stromal tumour (GIST): British Sarcoma Group clinical practice guidelines
before.evidence_summary: 低风险GIST随访获益及最优频率证据有限，若随访通常采用腹部CT或MRI等并按风险安排。
